PM Modi to Distribute Over 51,000 Appointment Letters at Rozgar Mela

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to distribute over 51,000 appointment letters to new recruits on Saturday, September 19, during the 20th Rozgar Mela. The appointments will be made across various government departments, including the Ministry of Railways and the Ministry of Defence. This event aims to provide employment opportunities and support the nation's workforce.
